notes.title: Smart AI Update is LIVE
notes.notes:
Hello all!

At last the update is live! Now you can have our major update which changes the AI system of the game complelety.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/NKrQnd6/ZIIVwb.gif[/img]

When you start to download, you'll see that it's massive in size. It's because we have also changed the design of all the levels for this new system. So the game must be updated with most of the content. Now both you and the AI will have lots of places to hide and cover. You can use these places for your combat tactics. And be careful, now AI can think of these tactics too.

In addition to this we have made several adjustements for game balance such as damage and weapon values. Weapon Station's weapon prices were also changed. There was a bug about the shield not regenerating in a given time so we fixed it too.

We have been working on this nearly for more than a month. We hope you like our new system and have great fun playing the game.

This update has been made with the help of your suggestions. So once again, we want to thank you for all your support and feedback.

Please feel free to tell us your new suggestions and issues (if you encounter any). We'd more than happy to help.

Here is the video from last week's update:

[previewyoutube=-Pv5NHTpbhg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks and have fun!

Ismail Kemal Ciftcioglu
Co-founder & Director

notes.title: Update on Smart AI
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

I wanted to give you an update about what we're doing with our new AI system.

So far everything's going as planned and smooth as possible. We're not also adapting our old smart system to the VR but also further upgrading it with better systems for a great experience.

When we release this update we think there will be a significant change in the gameplay as we are also updating damage and health values of all the AIs and weapons. These AIs will be able to hide, cover, regroup, throw grenades, suicide on you and move to tactical positions to positions so they will be much tougher to kill but we expect it to be much more fun than the actual systems for players who want more realistic and hardcore experiences.

Here is a test video of AI in action taken directly from Unreal Editor (sorry for poor video quality) :

[previewyoutube=1NbB5e07rHo;full][/previewyoutube]

The test phase will start this week so we expect to make it live very soon if we don't encounter anything weird. So stay tuned:)

Thank you for all your feedback and suggestions!

Ismail Kemal Ciftcioglu
Co-founder & Director

notes.title: Smart AI Announcement and New Features
notes.notes:
Hello again everyone!

I'd like to share more details about upcoming new features that I told you in our Index Patch announcement. Since the announcement was about Valve Index, I thought most people who have no interest in Index didn't see it.

As you see, since day 1, we have always been listening to you and spending our time on working with game balance, new features, changes and fixes. Thanks to your incredible feedback, we were able to take The Stranger to another level with more options and features.

Now here are some features that we're working right now to include in our upcoming patches:

[h3][b]SMART AI[/b][/h3]

Originally we begun The Stranger as a[b] non-VR[/b] [b]open world FPS [/b]project. We have created an [b]advanced AI [/b]with [b]voice recognition[/b] technology. Our aim was to create a Multiplayer experience in a Single Player game. We were planning to include a VR option as well. Then we saw that graphical limitations and the whole VR gaming experience is much more different than a regular PC shooter gameplay, we decided to create the VR version of Stranger first.

Here is a [b]Pre-Alpha environment video[/b] of the project. Maybe you can spot familiar environments from The Stranger VR as well:

https://youtu.be/MaXGITAXexU

And this was a[b] concept trailer[/b] created from an [b]early version[/b] of the game:

https://youtu.be/Se5nI5EE29U

After we start the VR version, most common feedback we have received from testers were about the AI. They said it wasn't so much fun because it's too hard to play. Because our AI back then had features like [b]cover, group, flee, regroup, throw grenades, make suicide attempts, fall back and strike again[/b]; they said it was too tiring to kill them thus eliminating the fun element. 

We were wrong to accept this statement and made our AI less smarter to ease the gameplay of the VR version. We thought that most comfortable VR shooting experience can be achieved with an AI that don't move so much and don't force us to move 360 degree to make strategy, cover etc. That's why we have created an extremely basic version from a monster we called [b]Smart AI[/b]. 

Now in our [b]next upcoming content patch[/b], we'll be introducing this system to you. Of course we will not be forcing everyone to play a much more harder game. It will be available to be turned on/off in the [b]Comfort Options.[/b]

Hopefully I'll post some videos from the latest footage in a few days.

[h3][b]DOUBLE HANDED GUNS[/b][/h3]

Yeap. After Smart AI, this is the feature we'd like to add so that you'll be able to shoot with two guns at the same time.

We'll start with pistol version. Like other guns we are planning to create 4 customizations as well. When you wield double handed weapons, you will not be able to throw grenades and use your wrist blade as the controls will be used for your left hand weapon. When you select next or previous weapon, you'll be able to continue using your grenades and wrist blade.

If you liked what we did, we'll continue adding new weapons to double handed series. So when we do this, double handed pistols will be the 6th weapon apart from regular pistols, energy guns, shotguns, flak cannons and rocket launchers.

So these two are the most important contents we're planning to do. If you have additional suggestions, feel free to write and give your opinion. We're always happy to have your feedback whether they are positive or negative. This is how we develop our game and ourselves further.

Our Best;

Ismail Kemal Ciftcioglu
Co-Founder & Director

notes.title: Valve Index Support Patch
notes.notes:
Hello again everyone!

As you know, our game needed an Index support but we couldn't afford them. But we have found a way! 

We have found a VR Cafe in the city which has Index devices. We introduced ourselves and they said ok for a full day rent of a device and a testing room. Though we also needed our own computers so we established ourselves to their storage & server room and worked there for a day to create our Index Support Patch :)

[img]https://i.ibb.co/r4GWBrv/002.jpg[/img]

So here we are. With the Index patch we also introduced new Graphics and Comfort Options. Here is the full list:

- Now we support Valve Index headset and controllers.

- If you use Index controllers, you can change your hand grip's degree in the Comfort Options.

- We have updated our device detection system thus edited our Tutorial images. Now only the device you are using can be seen on Tutorial images. That gives a more clear and understandable UI.

- The Options is divided into three categories. Sound, Graphics and Comfort.

- The visuals are more crisp now. But you can also edit Anti-Alising settings in the Graphics Options for your liking.

- We have added a Bloom settings to Graphics Options. You can adjust Bloom or turn it off completely.

[b]Ok so what's in for future? [/b]

These are things we have discussed and are making now for future patches:

[b]- Smarter AI: [/b]Originally, our AI system was much more advanced and smart. But we have decided to make it extremely basic. Because the testers we have tested the game thought the AI was too hard to kill and struggle in VR and they said it's no fun. So in order to ease the gameplay and higher the fun element, we basically made our AI less intelligent. 

But after we saw your comments about the AI system we decided to introduce the original system to you. Of course that will be a choice you can set in the Options so we will not be forcing anyone into a more harder game. But this is one of the most important things we are working now.
[b]
- Double weapons: [/b]We will be starting our double weapons packs (will be completely free) with double pistols in near future. We thought about something like this: When you select a double weapon, you will not be using grenades or wrist blade, the left controller's trigger will be used for your left weapon. If you press next weapon, you'll be able to use grenades and wrist blade again.

If you have any suggestions for anything just feel free to write in the discussion boards or you can email us at info@realityartsstudio.com. We always read and answer emails and as you know I'm always active in the boards.

If you encounter any issues or having difficulties with anything on our new patch, please tell us so we'll look into them right away.

Stay safe and have fun!

Ismail Kemal Ciftcioglu
Co-founder & Director

notes.title: Smooth Turning Patch!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We always listen to you and try to live up to expectations. We are a very small team ( 3 ) but we are trying do our best to create the best experience for you. 

Since our launch, some of you wanted Smooth Turning in The Stranger. We haven't made this for the original game because we thought it's not a preferred choice for turning. But we can be wrong and there is also nothing wrong about this we think:) We are also learning about what you want to experience in our game. And we'll continue to create new functionalities and content for your liking. 

So your feedback is very valuable to us!

So... What did we do today? Here is the list:

- We integrated Smooth Turning. Now with the [b]right joystick[/b] of [b]Oculus[/b], you can smooth turn. For [b]Vive[/b], you must press and hold the [b]Right Controller's Bottom Trackpad[/b] and [b]move your finger [/b]on the [b]Trackpad[/b] to[b] right[/b] and [b]left[/b].

- Tutoral level was edited to cover Smooth Turning after Quick Turn.

- We have created a new Comfort Options in Options Menu.

- You can change the speed of Smooth Turning in the Comfort Options.

- You can also turn on/off Smooth Turning completely in the Comfort Options.

- Again in the Comfort Options, you can change the degree of Snap Turn (Quick Turn). Now you can cycle between 45, 90 and 180 degree turns.

- Vibration On/Off was taken to Comfort Options.

If you think we can adjust things further please don't hesitate to write your suggestions. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts and change / develop things further.

Our Best;
RealityArts Team

notes.title: Today Is The Stranger Day! Some Tips & Information for Today's Release
notes.notes:
Finally the time has come! The Stranger VR will be out in few hours. 

We are a 3 people team and a huge effort was made in creating this game. We really hope it will be a satisfying and incredibly fun experience for you. We know that not everyone is perfect so feel free to send your feedback, suggestions or anything you wish to tell! 

You can either use Steam Discussion boards or send a direct email to info@realityartsstudio.com. We read and answer every email!

Before you play we'd like to remind you a few things we have seen in some online streams;

First, we advise you to play the tutorial! :) It's not a boring, never ending thing like in other games:) And in the end you'll enter an arena in infinite health and weapon choices to exercise before the actual journey begins.

Also, you'll learn how to use grenade & wrist blade with your left hand, as well as changing weapons, using waypoints etc. 

The energy weapons have infinite ammo in The Stranger. We didn't want you to cut your gameplay fun and look for ammo. So just hit with everything you got! But rocket & shell based weapons such as Rocket Launchers and Flak Cannons need ammo which you create from Ammo Stations along the way. Ammo Stations are also very useful to replenish your shield & health. Just take a couple of minutes in the Tutorial and you'll learn it all.

Then you are completely free and alone in the world of The Stranger. Again, we wish you an exciting, happy and fun game!

Our Best;
RealityArts Team
